name: Porter Metrics
description:
Porter Metrics connects Claude to the marketing platforms you already run on, so you can ask questions of live campaign data and act on the answers in the same conversation.

ASK IN PLAIN LANGUAGE
Describe what you want to know and Porter resolves the accounts, metrics and date range, then returns real numbers from your connected platforms - spend by campaign, channel comparisons, week-over-week movement.

PUBLISH REPORTS PEOPLE CAN OPEN
Porter builds hosted dashboards at a stable URL, not chat artifacts. Charts render against live data. Share by link, grant view or edit access by email, schedule delivery, or duplicate a report onto another client's accounts.

SAVE THE ANALYSES YOU REPEAT
A blend is a named cross-connector set of accounts you can query by name and export on a schedule to BigQuery, Google Sheets, Looker Studio or Power BI.

DO THE WORK, NOT JUST THE READING
One action catalog fronts 750+ operations across ~40 categories: create and edit campaigns, budgets, audiences and assets on the major ad platforms; and work across CRM, email marketing, e-commerce and SEO. Describe the task; Porter finds the action and runs it.

29 CONNECTORS, INCLUDING
Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads, Pinterest Ads, Reddit Ads, X Ads, Apple Ads, Google DV360, Google Analytics 4, Facebook and Instagram Insights, LinkedIn Pages, TikTok Insights, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Shopify, Amazon Seller, WooCommerce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL and Google Sheets.

Built for marketers, agencies and analysts who spend the day moving between ad managers, spreadsheets and reporting tools.

Reads and writes are separated: querying and previewing change nothing, and every write to a third-party platform runs through one tool annotated destructive, so Claude asks before it acts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Porter Metrics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Porter Metrics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://lite-mcp.portermetrics.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Porter Metrics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porter Metrics lists 28 MCP tools, including bigquery_join, connect_account, create_blend, create_report, delete_blend, delete_report, disconnect_account, duplicate_report, edit_report, execute_action, get_blend, and get_knowledge.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Porter Metrics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Porter Metrics in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Porter Metrics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porter Metrics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Porter Metrics is developed by Porter Metrics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
